_comment: Tileset metadata shared by tools/gen-garden-map.cjs (which writes garden.tmj's `tilesets` array and does the gid arithmetic) and gardenArt.ts (which loads the images in this exact order, so texture[i] lines up with tilesets[i]). Keeping one copy means map gids can never drift from the runtime painter. `image` paths are relative to assets/.

animation._comment: The sheet is 8 copies of one 11x8-tile block, differing only in water phase. Block k sits at column bx=k%blocksAcross, row by=floor(k/blocksAcross).
